name: Análisis de Diversidad de Vocabulario
description: Mide diversidad léxica and word choice patrones para identificar generado por IA text.
useCase: Detecting AI text through análisis of vocabulary richness and word repetition patrones
mechanism: Calcula multiple diversidad léxica metrics including Type-Token Ratio (TTR), Hapax Legomena ratio, and vocabulary growth rate. generado por IA text often exhibits different vocabulary distribución patrones compared to escritura humana — typically using a narrower range of words with more repetitive phrasing.
source: Dugan et al. (2023) - Real or Fake Text?: Investigating Human Ability to Detect Boundaries Between Human-Written and Machine-Generated Text, AAAI
algorithm: Type-Token Ratio (TTR) + Hapax Legomena + Vocabulary Growth Rate + Yule's K
parameters: Window: 100-500 tokens, Metrics: TTR, MTLD, HD-D, Yule's K
strengths:
• Captures fundamental patrones of word choice
• Language-model agnostic detección
• Works a través de multiple languages
• Computacionalmente ligero
limitations:
• Topic-dependent vocabulary variation
• Short texts reduce precisión
• Technical/specialized text has naturally limited vocabulary
• AI models are improving diversidad de vocabulario

references.title: Dugan, L. et al. (2023). Real or Fake Text? AAAI.
Uchendu, A. et al. (2020). Authorship Attribution for Neural Text Generation. EMNLP.
Guo, B. et al. (2023). How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? Comparison Corpus, Evaluation, and Detection. arXiv.
